column2: ‘Haven’t taught him how to fight,’ my ass! How the hell did you train this little monster?
But if I was going down, I was going to make sure to take that bastard down with me!
I’d had all that, but never in a million years would I choose it over what I’d had in the town of Ashber.
Continue proudly with your life and gain the strength to protect your loved ones from harm.
This isn’t the time to be moping. Get off your sorry ass and take care of the one who’s actually alive!
Ugh, wife? I didn’t know you could marry demons. You’re turning her into a monster, Gramps.
The cruel truth, though, was that no matter what kind of revenge I took, it didn’t change what had happened.
This life was going to be different. I wasn’t going to let the ones I treasured suffer.
No point in acting like someone who no longer existed.
Go back to the damn hole you crawled out from, you oversized tree! Impact Barrage!
If I’d left you there half-dead, that would put me at the same level as that ass Lucas, then, wouldn’t it?
If you can somehow get me in, I’ll go. After all, someone’s going to have to hold you back from murdering Lucas on the first day of school.
Wow, here I am, planning the downfall of one of the great houses, and you’re thinking about girls.
For that, I would be willing to sell even my soul.
Mr. Gideon, let me make it clear that I’m not here to indulge your selfish curiosities.
The Ravenpoop family? Never heard of a family named after bird feces. Have you, Art?
With fighting, the only things you get better at are destroying and killing, but the better you get at artificing, the more things you can create.
You guys are both pretty ugly to me. Ow! That seriously hurts right now!
Having a family that I would happily die for reminded me of how truly weak I was.
This also meant I had to be stronger than my past self, since I had people to protect this time.
Always assume the opponent is stronger than you, and try your best.
I don’t know what’s going on, but I’m getting you guys out of here if it’s the last thing I do.
I always thought I didn’t need anyone… as long as I was strong enough.
The weight of a country I’d had no affection for in my previous life couldn’t compare to the few lives I would give everything for in this one.
I want you to come to us so we can be there for you. I don’t ever want you to feel like you can’t come home, that you aren’t welcome.
Come on, let’s go home. Inside, a more ferocious beast than anything you’ve ever faced awaits.
God, am I glad you’re still alive, brat. I’m becoming somewhat thankful for your cockroach-like tenacity.
Before you are a princess, you are a person. It doesn’t matter if someone is a king, a servant, a powerful mage, an elf, or a dwarf. A person is a person.
People do bad things for good reasons, so don’t just take them for what they do on the surface. Keep your mind sharp.
You are but a mere tool. You will do as I say, no questions asked. If you display this sort of ignorance again, there will be consequences.
Taking measures to ensure your filth won’t spread to the next generation.
What we’re doing is abandoning our people so we can save our own asses
I would like to believe that it is for the good of this continent that you become a sacrifice.
The heart remains the brain’s biggest enemy. Well, actually, for men, the brain’s most formidable foe is probably…
Small steps, Arthur. You have much to learn, but much to unlearn as well.
I hadn’t fought through two lives to die in a ditch at the claws of a wild animal…
In this world, though, was I willing to sacrifice my loved ones for the greater good? Undoubtedly not.
Well, the fact is that you’re a walking collection of statistical improbabilities.
Arthur, although the full army has yet to arrive… the war has already started.
Trust is a fickle serpent; laboriously gained yet so easily lost.
Fine! You know what? The more of you I kill, the fewer of my soldiers will die!
You’re unbelievable. Your thoughts immediately go to whether I got promoted? You almost died, Arthur!
I think being able to overcome such a huge obstacle and move forward with a smile says much more about you than the color of a mana core ever could.
Your most fearsome rival in love can’t even admit to her feelings, Kathyln.
Are you guys done or do you want to level a mountain while you’re at it?
I’m afraid that, when I awaken as a full asura, I won’t be able to assist you anymore.
you’re the only one on this continent that I’m interested in.
What happens when your foe, who has crossed both time and space, is actually brighter than thee?
It’s just one damned Alacryan. How the hell did they manage to make it this far north?
I love you too, idiot. But we’re at war. We both have responsibilities, and people that need us.
A promise to stay alive—so that we can have a future together, a relationship… a family.
We have no choice but to kill for a greater cause; don’t take joy in it.
Oh no, friend Oberle, you are Mica’s guide now, and you will not leave Mica’s side.
The least I can do is trust you—at least until you give me a reason not to.
It was just one man, but that one man had been a walking catastrophe.
Behold, master. I—Regis, the mighty weapon gifted to you by the asuras so long ago—have finally manifested in all my glory!
At least buy me a drink first!
I’d clap slowly, applauding you for your incredible foresight but—y’know—no hands.
Well, it’d be better than having you shout out, ‘Regis, enter my hand!’ That’s pretty much the worst battle cry I’ve ever heard.
I’m sorry, Arthur, but you basically ate this bug’s crap!
Let’s see what fresh slice of hell awaits us next.
If it wasn’t for me, you would’ve died doing that dragon’s fart technique!
I liked you better when you were depressed.
Check me out. I’m majestic as fuck!
The word ‘honorable’ has no meaning to a man who plunders his own teammate’s body for equipment.
Those two traits aren’t necessarily mutually exclusive,
I have a sister as well, and I know what I’d do—what I have done—to keep her safe.
Until such a time, though, we’ll deliver our boots to Alacryan asses wherever we can find them.
It’s unreasonable for you to trust me after how I deceived you, but a close alternative to trust is mutually assured destruction,
Imagine those being your last words.
You know, out of the two of you, I think your brother was the one that got the looks,
I got what I wanted. Consider this as one last favor… for Grey.
Nothing says love like painting each other in the blood of your enemies.
Don’t pretend that you care about me. You’ve only seen me as a weapon, a tool for you to use! Now that you’ve seen my potential, you’re scared of me, aren’t you?
With aether, I could rewrite reality itself, it was only a matter of learning how.
Should have just killed the girl.
Well, there’s a good chance your lady love has been erased and replaced with the super-powerful chick you murdered in a previous life. Sound about right?
Grey didn’t kill my brothers.
I decided “Orb of Long-term Stalking” was way too long. Creeper’s Stone rolls right off the tongue—figuratively speaking.
Did you personally transform him from a normal person into a mule’s ass?
To wield aether, you must forget that there are rules to things.
You had a purpose, which you dutifully, albeit unknowingly, served.
After everything you’ve done to me, you owe me this. You owe me Grey.
So…you want to grab some shawarma on the way back?
Good enough for who? The crowd of pompous highbloods? Your classmates?
I’ve learned a few tricks since we last met. I hope you have as well, otherwise this will be over far too soon.
Neither are you, obviously. But we should be afraid to become as bad as the thing we’re fighting against.
Don’t worry about me. I’ve got all the time in the world.
You need friends in low places, and nobody’s got more friends, and none lower, than me.
Only that having one of these runes tends to coincide with being a homicidal maniac set on following a living deity into war with the kingdom of the gods
Be glad that you, in your death, will be more useful than you ever were in your long and wasted life.
Sure. But my rule hasn’t changed. You can start dating…when your date can beat me in a fight.
Hope is enough, for now. It has to be, because it is all we have.
Maybe you’ve forgotten because you’ve been looking upon my beautiful face for so long, but I’m a god-weapon, remember?
We can change the narrative of our lives. We can make the Sovereigns bleed!
I knew before we entered the portal that I would not be returning.
